nodes.label: Qualitative Comparison Table
nodes.rationale: CDC: no app coupling, ~0 write overhead, eventual availability, failure isolation, high ops complexity; triggers/Envers: immediate, same-DB IO competition, mutation fails if audit fails; Envers misses non-ORM writes

nodes.label: API-key Auth (user_api_account access JSONB)

nodes.rationale: One user per k6 VU because of maximumSessions(1) and re-login per iteration

nodes.label: CDC Audit Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Mutations captured from WAL and fanned out to SSE + TimescaleDB archive without coupling to application code

nodes.label: DB Triggers Audit Method (capture_trigger_audit)
nodes.rationale: Synchronous, inside mutation txn; toggled via ALTER TABLE DISABLE/ENABLE TRIGGER

nodes.label: Hibernate Envers Audit Method
nodes.rationale: OFF by default; envers profile flips ddl-auto=update; REVINFO pre-created because validate checks mapped @Entity

nodes.label: Audit-method Comparison Results (markdown)
nodes.rationale: CDC +5.1% create p50 overhead vs baseline, smallest storage 219.6 B/row, lag p50 562.5 ms; triggers 1247 B/row; Envers most rows (8331)

nodes.label: k6 Load Model (per-VU user, re-login per iteration)
nodes.norm_label: k6 load model (per-vu user, re-login per iteration)
nodes.rationale: Login cost identical across scenarios and excluded from op latency trends; throughput is login-bound

nodes.label: CDC Contract (Debezium table.include.list / REPLICA IDENTITY FULL)
nodes.norm_label: cdc contract (debezium table.include.list / replica identity full)
nodes.rationale: Excludes *_trigger_audit, *_aud, revinfo so CDC never audits other methods' output; excludes date_created/last_updated; REPLICA IDENTITY FULL gives before+after images

nodes.label: Table-agnostic Audit Consumer Routing to <table>_audit
nodes.rationale: New source tables need only a matching hypertable, no consumer code change

nodes.label: Row-carried Audit Attribution (last_user_id, change_reason)
nodes.rationale: Attribution flows through the row, not the DB connection, so it survives Debezium to the audit consumer

nodes.label: Fully Reactive SSE Bridge
nodes.rationale: Must stay non-blocking: Reactor Kafka + WebFlux + R2DBC, no JDBC/JPA
